capabilities: capture memos via the input card, a global popup command, or iOS Shortcuts URIs
browse day-grouped memos in a waterfall timeline with pinning, starring, and soft delete
search and filter memos by combined tags and keywords
attach images by paste, drag, or file picker into vault attachments
view statistics reports with heatmaps, calendar, top tags, and a year panorama
extras: Currently manual-install only (via Releases or BRAT); the README mixes English and Chinese, with full English documentation in README.en.md; iOS Shortcuts capture supports text only, not images.
intentEvidence: A flomo-style fleeting-thoughts plugin for Obsidian
motivation: The author wanted a place for随手记-style thoughts without backlinks, graphs, or folder decisions, while keeping the notes as plain Markdown files they could always grep.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in quick-capture stream for fleeting thoughts; everyday note-taking pushes users toward folders and links instead of a fast timeline.
